verdict.rationale: Sprinto docs include a page titled 'Selecting an Audit Partner,' implying the platform facilitates connecting founders with audit partners rather than being a pure DIY tool, and collaborative tooling lets teams 'work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.' However, there is no evidence of a vetted/curated auditor marketplace, in-house audit arm, or any published timeline/SLA commitments for booking an audit through Sprinto itself. missing for 10: details on the auditor network/marketplace mechanics, published timeline guarantees, evidence of actually booking an audit via Sprinto rather than just coordinating with an externally chosen auditor.
